name: Secondary / integrator: refurbished 8x H100 SXM5 server node (whole-system band)
price_basis: REFURBISHED full 8-GPU SERVER (Dell PowerEdge XE9680, Xeon Platinum 8462Y+, 8x HGX H100 80GB SXM5 NVLink, with baseboard and host), USD, observed 2026-10-03. This is a configured-system price and is NOT comparable to any bare-card figure in this slice. Implied per-GPU $22,500 is a DIVISION, not an observed card price.
notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Sources sup-price-serverpartdeals-h100 (the only observed price) and sup-price-picclick-ebay-asking (a second, independent whole-node data point: an 'HGX H100 8*80GB baseboard' listing at $341,872.75 - note that listing is a baseboard whose title does not state whether GPUs are included, so it is logged as corroboration of scale only, NOT as a second price for the same object). STATUS CAVEAT: the ServerPartDeals listing was marked Out of stock / Sold out at observation and its product URL now 404s, so this is a recently-realised price rather than a live one. n=1 for the server basis. WHY THIS RECORD IS THE ANCHOR: dividing by 8 gives $22,500/node for the GPU content, which is BELOW the ~$26,880 SXM asking band and far below the ~$43,000 PCIe asking band. The spread between whole-node and bare-card figures is exactly the systematic error this slice exists to prevent - a node price read as a card price overstates by ~8x, and a card price read as a node price understates by ~8x.
